query: SELECT t.id, t.channel_id, t.lead_conversation, t.state, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.deadline_at)::bigint AS "deadline_at!", (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.deadline_at - t.created_at) / 60)::int AS "deadline_minutes!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages n WHERE n.channel_id = t.channel_id AND n.type = 'notice' AND n.body->>'kind' = 'deadline_near') AS "deadline_notified!", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM GREATEST(t.created_at, (SELECT MAX(c.created_at) FROM channel_messages c WHERE c.channel_id = t.channel_id AND c.author_kind <> 'gateway'), (SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL AND (e.conversation_id = t.lead_conversation OR e.conversation_id IN (SELECT m.conversation_id FROM agent_team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id)))))::bigint AS "last_activity_at!" FROM agent_teams t WHERE t.state <> 'ended' ORDER BY t.created_at
